name: io.github.Servosity/connectsecure-mcp
title: ConnectSecure MCP
description: Vulnerability management across all ConnectSecure clients: exposure ranking, CVE impact, blind spots

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your tenant's pod URL, e.g. https://pod104.myconnectsecure.com (Profile > API Documentation in the portal). Each tenant has its own pod; there is no working default.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Tenant name you type on the ConnectSecure portal login screen.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: API client ID from Settings > Users > (user) > API Key.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API client secret from Settings > Users > (user) > API Key.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A pre-minted JWT from /w/authorize; while it is unexpired it is used instead of minting one. The tenant, client ID and secret are still needed so the CLI can mint a fresh token once it expires.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional user_id from /w/authorize. Only needed with a pre-minted access token; minting fills it automatically.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write and hide the sync, export and tail tools (import is never an MCP tool). Credential reads are still answered.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectSecure requests.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTSECURE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to a tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. This connector registers none; leave unset.
